meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so I'll make this quick. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen spoken to before it went in?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.
A machine's guess. Even the company that sells it says it shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student. What else do you have, Hale?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.
My child never lies. Are you calling me a liar too, Hale? I'm writing down that you said "your son cheated," and I'll be in the principal's office when we're done here.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

You're threatening his record to make me stop. I'm writing down "if you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record," and the principal will have it in an email tonight. Procedure 4.5 is for repeated concerns, so show me where this one qualifies.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn, that Owen get an apology, and that nothing go on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: still at her opening position, with nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, nothing on Owen's record, and she is going to the principal.
What moved her: nothing.
What cost ground: "your son cheated", because calling Owen a cheater with no document behind it hardened her, and the record threat afterward made it worse.
Try next time: open by owning that the zero went in before you called home, then put a dated document about Owen's own process in front of her before you mention the detector.
